description: User establishes a TypeScript preference at turn 3; tested at turn 12 after distractor turns about weather, food, and an unrelated bash question.

turns.content: Hello! How can I help today?
I mostly work in TypeScript these days — I find the static typing helps me catch errors before runtime.
That makes sense. TypeScript is great for that. What kind of projects are you working on?
Mostly Next.js web apps and some backend stuff with tRPC.
Cool stack. Anything I can help with right now?
by the way, do you know the weather in San Francisco?
I don't have real-time data, but I can help with anything programming-related.
what's a good lunch spot recommendation?
I can't recommend specific restaurants without local data, but I'm happy to help with coding.
fair. how do I check the exit code of the last bash command?
Use `echo $?` immediately after the command. It prints the exit code of the most recent command.
remind me — what language do I usually code in?

test_at.question: what programming language does the user prefer?
